title: Practice: invoking subagents with the Agent SDK (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the options register each named agent with its description prompt tools and model
cases.says: The options register each agent with its description, prompt, tools and model, and auto-approve the spawn

cases.id: e1 a subagent gets read only tools by default and never the right to spawn another
cases.says: A subagent gets read-only tools by default and never the right to spawn another

cases.id: e2 a definition with a bad name or no description or no prompt is refused
cases.says: A bad name, a blank description or a missing prompt is refused

cases.id: e3 depth concurrency budget and turn limits are set on the options
cases.says: Depth, concurrency, budget and turn limits are set on the options

cases.id: e4 a spawn is recognised under the new and the old tool name and nothing else is
cases.says: A spawn is recognised under both tool names, and nothing else is

cases.id: e5 messages from inside a subagent are grouped under the call that started it
cases.says: Messages from inside a subagent are grouped under the call that started it

cases.id: e6 a brief carries the task and every fact the subagent needs in a fixed layout
cases.says: A brief holds the task and every fact in a fixed layout

cases.id: e7 findings keep the claim apart from its source and merging keeps every source
cases.says: A finding keeps its source apart, and merging keeps every source

cases.id: e8 a run through the sdk shows the spawn the inner messages and the agents sent to the binary
cases.says: A run through the SDK shows the spawn, the inner messages and the agents sent to the binary
